The guide:

Title "# Deployment"
Docker Compose with three services table. Host ports only localhost. Notes. Media volume. No external object storage.

Setup:
cp .env.example .env
# set at minimum: PAYLOAD_SECRET, HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL (see docs/env-reference.md)
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose ps # wait for healthy
curl http://localhost:3020/api/health
Compose fails fast missing required vars intentional.
Build-time args note.

Domains:
One deployment serves both hosts; middleware splits (see architecture.md). Domain mapping. Point DNS. Board WS endpoint set wss URL proxied to 1234; ws blocked mixed content.

Nginx sketch. It includes server blocks no ssl_certificate, no listen 80 redirect, no proxy headers for websockets beyond upgrade. But sketch.

Production override:
Same pattern as another stack: docker-compose.prod.yml hardens base for VPS.
set MONGO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD.
command.
What changes: MongoDB root auth, init only empty volume, existing volume create user by hand command. Mongo no host port. restart always. mailpit profile and SMTP.

Backup & restore:
scripts/backup.sh dumps db and tars media_data + uploads_data volumes into ../backups rotating 14 days. Cron example. Restore command. Both scripts read env.

Updates:
git pull
docker compose ... up -d --build web hocuspocus

Demo accounts:
seed command defaults, env vars. What script does, read-only, hocuspocus image rebuilt after updating.

- No verifying hocuspocus health? Only web health. Could curl websocket? no.
- No verifying prod override after enabling auth? No.
- Backup/restore included though not strictly install.
- No troubleshooting.
- Demo accounts not required.
